carrier_semantics: A runtime handle denotes a finite R_N=Z/NZ module and is affine/linear: every consuming constructor invalidates its input handles.
pre_readout_scalar_semantics: Arbitrary pure integer computation on public intensional data is allowed. No scalar observation of the runtime handle state is primitive.

constructor_semantics.NEW_FREE(r): denotes R_N^r and compiles to the r x 0 empty presentation matrix
constructor_semantics.DIRECT_SUM(H1,H2): consumes both handles and returns their direct sum; presentations compile by block diagonal sum
constructor_semantics.TENSOR(H1,H2): consumes both handles and returns their tensor product over R_N; if C is rxs and D is uxv, compile to [C tensor I_u | I_r tensor D]

terminal_boundary.semantics: Consume the final handle and return one finite presentation matrix for its module.
terminal_boundary.declared_readout: Compute the maximal-minor determinantal divisor Delta_r(C) of the materialized presentation and output gcd(N,Delta_r(C)).
terminal_boundary.oracle_guard: MATERIALIZE returns a presentation, not a factor, nonunit, CRT side, hidden prime, or factor-aware selector.

public_trace_compiler.claim: The finite public constructor transcript determines a presentation matrix before MATERIALIZE by structural recursion.
public_trace_compiler.tensor: C,D -> [C tensor I_u | I_r tensor D]
public_trace_compiler.resource_note: The compiler reads the public transcript, not runtime handles, so affine/linear noncopyability does not block it.

support_scalar.definition: For an integer rxs presentation C, Delta_r(C)=1 when r=0, Delta_r(C)=0 when s<r, and otherwise the gcd of all r x r minors. For squarefree N=pq, support_scalar(C;N)=gcd(N,Delta_r(C)).
support_scalar.theorem: For ell in {p,q}, ell divides Delta_r(C) iff rank(C mod ell)<r iff coker(C mod N) has nonzero ell-CRT component. Hence support_scalar is exactly the product of supported hidden primes.
support_scalar.one_sided_consequence: A one-sided hidden support state forces 1<gcd(N,Delta_r(C))<N, computable from public transcript before MATERIALIZE.

scope_boundary: No claim about capability calculi containing a load-bearing transition whose realized output is not effectively presentation-compilable from the public transcript.
No factoring lower bound, complexity lower bound, novelty, Working Truth, Foundation, or canonical promotion claim.
The next necessary semantic gap is simultaneous extensional nonreflection and intensional presentation noncompilability, with a separately non-oracular terminal readout.

tool_reuse_resolution.T0_BRC: NOT_APPLICABLE: current proof uses CRT module support, not Boolean/provenance BRC support; do not conflate the typings.
tool_reuse_resolution.T6_OPERATION_SAFE_QUOTIENT: NOT_APPLICABLE: module cokernels here are algebraic presentations, not a chosen semantic coarse-graining/observation quotient.
